title: Let seeking kneel before it wanders
summary: The verse does not flatter spiritual novelty; it returns the heart to where truth can actually be kept. Do not let the day outrun this: keep this in front of you: seeking matures when it bows into the Name and service.
takeaway: Bring the question near a line you can actually keep.
lifeApplication: Before starting one more search, stay with the shelter already in front of you and keep one line there.

source.shortMeaning: Release is found where Naam and service meet the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: Before trying another method, do one act of service and repeat the Name until the search stops performing itself.
